facts.claim: From 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 Barcelona's tourist tax (Catalan rate + €5 city surcharge) is €12 a person a night at five-star and grand luxe hotels, €8.40 at four-star, €9.50 in tourist flats, €6 in youth hostels and €7 in other establishments, including three-star hotels.

facts.claim: Catalonia's tax on stays exempts under-17s, is charged for at most 7 nights per person per continuous stay in one establishment, applies the rate in force at booking if the booking and tax are paid then, and forms part of the VAT base.
